author: Mark Atwood
text: Resolved: added Signing Model (issuer-signed vs x5chain attestation paths), Key Binding checks 1-4 (leaf key verifies sig; leaf-key IID == kid; SAN IID == kid; subject-iid == kid), rewrote Verification (chain validation per appendix §8 steps 1-3, bearer/attribution rule for third-party subjects, seq cache keyed (verification-key IID, subject-iid, claim-type) with no-entry/lt/eq/gt cases). 5 kimi-k3 review passes; 9 findings raised and fixed inline (wrong appendix § ref, authority-chain contradiction, seq-cache false rejection, bearer attribution gap, misstated key-resolution rationale, seq==cached re-presentation, chain validity-window omission, key-bound wording, missing no-cached-entry case). Final two passes PASS. Out-of-scope note: 03-addressing.md and appendix-x509-cert-profile.md still state SHA-512 derivation (known incomplete i72x migration); reviewed lines only delegate to them.
